# signoz_notification_channel (Resource)

Creates and manages notification channel resources in SigNoz.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    signoz = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/signoz/signoz"
    }
  }
}

provider "signoz" {
  endpoint     = "http://localhost:3301"
  access_token = "<SIGNOZ-API-KEY>"
}

resource "signoz_notification_channel" "slack_alerts" {
  name = "slack-alerts"
  type = "slack"

  slack_configs = {
    api_url = "https://hooks.example.com/services/TXXXXXXXXX/BXXXXXXXXX/xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
    channel = "#alerts"
    title   = "SigNoz Alert"
    text    = "Alert fired: {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}"
  }
}

output "slack_channel" {
  value = signoz_notification_channel.slack_alerts
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the notification channel.
- `type` (String) Type of the notification channel. Possible values are: slack, webhook, pagerduty, opsgenie, msteams, and email.

### Optional

- `email_configs` (Attributes) Email notification configuration. (see below for nested schema)
- `msteams_configs` (Attributes) Microsoft Teams notification configuration. (see below for nested schema)
- `opsgenie_configs` (Attributes) OpsGenie notification configuration. (see below for nested schema)
- `pagerduty_configs` (Attributes) PagerDuty notification configuration. (see below for nested schema)
- `slack_configs` (Attributes) Slack notification configuration. (see below for nested schema)
- `webhook_configs` (Attributes) Webhook notification configuration. (see below for nested schema)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Autogenerated unique ID for the notification channel.

### Nested Schema for `slack_configs`

Required:

- `api_url` (String) Slack webhook URL.

Optional:

- `channel` (String) Slack channel to send notifications to.
- `text` (String) Text of the Slack message.
- `title` (String) Title of the Slack message.

### Nested Schema for `webhook_configs`

Required:

- `api_url` (String) Webhook URL.

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for webhook authentication.
- `username` (String) Username for webhook authentication.

### Nested Schema for `pagerduty_configs`

Optional:

- `details` (Map of String) Additional details for PagerDuty.
- `routing_key` (String, Sensitive) PagerDuty routing key.
- `service_key` (String, Sensitive) PagerDuty service key.

### Nested Schema for `opsgenie_configs`

Required:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) OpsGenie API key.

Optional:

- `api_url` (String) OpsGenie API URL.

### Nested Schema for `msteams_configs`

Required:

- `webhook_url` (String) Microsoft Teams webhook URL.

### Nested Schema for `email_configs`

Required:

- `to` (String) Email address to send notifications to.

Optional:

- `headers` (Map of String) Additional email headers.
- `html` (String) HTML body of the email notification.
- `send_resolved` (Boolean) Whether to send a notification when the alert resolves.
